# GuestVerify — Smart-Home AI Gatekeeper

> Zero-Trust AI Visitor Verification gatekeeper for Ring Doorbell and smart home platforms, powered by Amazon Bedrock and deterministic policy engines.

## System Overview
GuestVerify is an intelligent smart-home gatekeeper designed to process visitor door interactions (motion triggers, doorbell chimes, two-way conversational audio) and enforce deterministic safety policies before any physical or simulated lock action is allowed.

## Architecture Principles
1. **AI Intent Extraction**: Uses Amazon Bedrock (Claude 3.5 Haiku) solely to parse unstructured speech transcripts into structured visitor claims (claimed identity, recipient, purpose, tracking numbers, and risk flags).
2. **Deterministic Policy Engine**: Pure rule-based policy verification compares visitor claims against active delivery databases and scheduled visitor windows.
3. **Fail-Closed Security Guarantee**: Any ambiguity, prompt injection attempt, missing schedule, or expired window triggers `DENIED_UNKNOWN` or `CREATE_SECURITY_ALERT`. The door remains strictly locked.

## Routes & Slugs
- `/`: Interactive Overview, 3D Doorbell Experience, scenario breakdowns, and architecture.
- `/console`: Single-screen live Ring doorbell simulation console with Bedrock AI intent extraction and policy verification.
- `/schedules`: Scheduled visitors, expected deliveries, recurring guest windows, and time-bound access management.
- `/events`: Real-time immutable audit trail and historical security events with decision rationale.
- `/settings`: Zero-trust security engine controls, fail-closed policy parameters, and telemetry status.
- `/contact`: Direct security architecture inquiry, enterprise deployment contact, and instant WhatsApp support.

## Developer & API Endpoints
- `POST /api/v1/ring-webhook`: Ingests Ring doorbell triggers.
- `GET /api/v1/schedules`: Retrieves active access schedules.
- `POST /api/v1/schedules`: Adds a new scheduled guest or expected delivery.
- `POST /api/v1/contact`: Validates and sanitizes inquiries with rate limiting.
- `GET /api/v1/stream`: Server-Sent Events (SSE) live updates.
- `GET /health`: System telemetry, Amazon Bedrock availability, and fail-safe status.
